releases.title: Your community, better connected.
releases.summary: Safer sharing, clearer unread activity, and more control over voice.

changes.title: Safer account and community access
changes.description: Private account data stays private while public profiles remain visible to your community.

changes.title: Invites you control
changes.description: Create, replace, or revoke invitation links for your conversations. Existing memberships stay intact.

changes.title: Voice and activity controls
changes.description: Choose your microphone, check voice connectivity, and keep track of unread messages and mentions.

releases.title: A safer foundation for your community.
releases.summary: Security maintenance across LYRIA and its mobile companion.

changes.title: Keeping the foundations current
changes.description: Security updates for the libraries that power LYRIA and its mobile app, with dependency checks for future changes.

changes.title: Report concerns privately
changes.description: A clear security policy explains how to report a vulnerability without posting sensitive details publicly.

releases.title: A little more room for your stories.
releases.summary: A new Community Journal, and a better way to catch up with LYRIA.

changes.title: Your own community publication
changes.description: Featured stories, categories, and a cleaner way to browse what’s happening around LYRIA.

changes.title: Stories worth settling into
changes.description: A dedicated reading view with author details, reading time, reactions, and comments. All existing articles and discussions are still here.

changes.title: A welcome with every update
changes.description: See what changed once per release, then get back to your space. Reopen What’s new beside your profile whenever you like.

releases.title: Your space, settled.
releases.summary: A calmer sidebar and a real home for your feedback.

changes.title: Your profile stays put
changes.description: Profile and settings stay pinned while conversations and voice rooms scroll independently.

changes.title: Ideas & feedback
changes.description: Send an idea or bug report, keep drafts after failed sends, and see confirmed submissions.

releases.title: Somewhere between conversations.
releases.summary: Browse your community without keeping a chat open.

changes.title: A conversation home
changes.description: Find your conversations, open Friends, or start something new from a dedicated hub.

changes.title: Pick up where you left off
changes.description: Saved login, channel and panel restoration, and in-app back links that return to your conversation hub.
